label_definition.negative: Finding Labels == 'No Finding' and patient never labeled Pneumonia
label_definition.excluded: pediatric, non-frontal and every other label combination

design: case-control; 3.0 control images per case image; one image per control patient
control_allocation: controls per split = global control/case ratio x case images in that split
reserved_for_audit: 110 patients with radiologist Pneumonia bounding boxes forced into external_test
selection_rule: Decided from metadata before any image is downloaded or any model is trained; external_test never informs training, early stopping, threshold or model selection.
